candidates.matter_content: Exact classical electrovac outside a charged timelike seam. A_t=1/(sqrt(G)U), Gaussian Maxwell normalization. Seam sigma=-(U+a U_n)/(2piG U^2 a), p=1/(4piG U a), q_s=-U_n/(2pi sqrt(G)U^2). sigma<0.
candidates.quantum_state: Not constructed on the quotient; no global Hadamard state or renormalized quantum realization of the seam has been supplied.
candidates.topology: One asymptotically flat spatial exterior with a handle joining two excised balls. Before adding holonomy there is one time coordinate; nonzero holonomy is prescribed in seam identification.
assumptions: Equal positive MP centre parameters, m>0, d>2a; the singular centres are removed.
Exact reflection isometry matches angle-dependent first fundamental forms.
Time holonomy is given as input geometry, not manufactured by a control protocol.
A charged negative-energy distributional seam is permitted at the classical diagnostic stage only.

candidates.boundary_conditions: Isometric timelike cut-and-paste, Israel stress and Maxwell current jumps. One asymptotic time normalization. No RN black-hole interior or inner Cauchy-horizon traversal is used.
symmetries: Static axisymmetric local metric; mouths not intrinsically round because U varies with polar angle.
candidates.approximation_order: Exact classical distributional Einstein-Maxwell construction. Not semiclassical and not a finite-thickness quantum solution. The axial optical path is a sufficient return route, not a certified globally shortest path.

stress_energy.formula: Bulk Maxwell plus explicit sigma,p,q_s at the seam. Proper seam energy=-2a(1+m/d)/G, charge=2m/sqrt(G), ADM mass at infinity=2m/G. These are distinct quantities, not an additive fabrication budget.
